children: Apeejay Surrendra Park Hotels Limited has appointed Manish Bhagat as Chief Financial Officer and Key Managerial Personnel, effective September 21, 2026. Bhagat succeeds Atul Khosla, who has stepped down from the role to pursue a new professional opportunity.

Bhagat brings more than 20 years of finance experience across hospitality, retail, engineering, aviation and aerospace. Prior to joining Apeejay Surrendra Park Hotels, he served as Vice President – Finance at SAMHI Hotels Limited, following leadership roles at Devyani International Limited, AirWorks Engineering Pvt Ltd, and InterGlobe Aviation Limited (IndiGo).

His experience spans financial planning and control, strategic financial management, treasury management, refinancing, cost optimisation, audits, due diligence controls and digital finance transformation.

Vijay Dewan, Managing Director, Apeejay Surrendra Park Hotels Limited, said, “We thank Mr Atul Khosla for his valuable contribution, commitment and work ethics and wish him the very best for the next chapter in his journey. We are delighted to welcome Manish Bhagat to Apeejay Surrendra Park Hotels. His extensive experience across hospitality and diverse sectors will bring valuable perspective to our leadership team as we continue to scale our business and drive sustainable growth. We look forward to his leadership and contribution in the journey ahead.”
